mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.0% signals economic distress and reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5% and the CPI index is below 220.0, it indicates a stable inflation environment with accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS<=0.5% AND CPIAUCSL<=220.0) fails to produce positive 60d returns in more than 40% of instances, or the interaction term's coefficient in a regression is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong growth regime defined by industrial production above 100.5 and unemployment below 5.0%, the economy is expanding with strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The strong growth regime (INDPRO>100.5 AND UNRATE<5.0%) fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 40% of instances, or the regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when RSAFS is above its 50th percentile, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 500 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 60% of instances when HOUST < 500.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above 100.0 and employment (PAYEMS) is above 130000, it indicates a strong economy with expanding production and labor markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (INDPRO>100.0 AND PAYEMS>130000.0) fails to produce positive 60d returns in more than 40% of instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a stagflation regime defined by CPIAUCSL above 220.0 and unemployment below 5.0%, the economy faces high inflation and low growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The stagflation regime (CPIAUCSL>220.0 AND UNRATE<5.0%) fails to produce negative 20d returns in more than 40% of instances, or the regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
